cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Content Creator position advertised by your company. With a solid background in digital marketing, SEO, and web content management, I am eager to apply my skills to planning, creating, and executing high-quality content across your digital platforms.

In my role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained practical experience in owning on-page SEO strategies from keyword research to publishing, consistently improving organic visibility for client websites. I specialize in writing keyword-targeted blog content, managing website updates within WordPress, and developing content that engages audiences across web and social media. My ability to write for different formats, combined with a strong understanding of content optimization, aligns well with the requirements of this role.

My personal project, mirook.com, further showcases my capabilities, where I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data for enhanced search visibility, and integrated social media. This experience highlights my creative mindset, attention to detail, and proactive approach to digital content strategy. I am proficient in tools like Canva and have a strong technical foundation from my coursework in Applied Computer Science, which enables me to quickly adapt to new platforms and technologies.

Although my current role is remote, I am based in Zwijndrecht and am keen to transition to an on-site position where I can collaborate directly with a dynamic team. I am confident in my time management and communication skills, honed through managing multiple client projects and personal initiatives.

Thank you for considering my application. I am keen to bring my passion for content creation and my technical expertise to your team and am available for an interview at your earliest convenience. I have attached my tailored CV for your detailed review.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
